components.css: .ds-room{overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #708da266;border-radius:16px;background:#081321b8;backdrop-filter:blur(18px);color:#f5f4fa;font-family:Inter,ui-sans-serif,system-ui,sans-serif}.ds-bar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:14px 18px;font-size:12px;border-bottom:1px solid #708da233}.ds-speaker{position:relative;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:220px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 90%,#1d658f55,transparent 75%)}.ds-name{position:absolute;bottom:12px;left:12px;padding:6px 12px;border-radius:6px;background:#040811db;font-size:14px}.ds-notice{margin:0;padding:12px 18px;font-size:12px;border-block:1px solid #708da233;color:#d2edfa}.ds-participants{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px;padding:12px}.ds-participant{min-height:80px;padding:8px;overflow:hidden;border:2px solid #516b8159;border-radius:10px;background:#121f31;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer}.ds-participant:has(input:checked){border-color:#b0edf9;background:#203f55}.ds-participant:hover{border-color:#b2c8e7}.ds-participant:focus-within{outline:3px solid #d3b0ff;outline-offset:2px}@media(min-width:640px){.ds-speaker{min-height:300px}.ds-participants{padding:20px}} .ds-layout{display:grid}.ds-focus{min-width:0;display:flex;flex-direction:column}.ds-focus .ds-speaker{flex:1}.ds-sidebar{padding:14px;background:#07111d99;border-top:1px solid #708da233}.ds-sidebar .ds-participants{padding:0;gap:10px}@media(min-width:768px){.ds-layout{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 190px}.ds-sidebar{border-top:0;border-left:1px solid #708da233}.ds-sidebar .ds-participants{grid-template-columns:1fr}.ds-focus .ds-speaker{min-height:380px}}

narrative.overview:
The implemented workspace uses a dark canvas, subtly separated panels, pale lavender actions, and compact sans-serif typography. Discover's role cards establish the shared visual vocabulary used by forms, application lists, and onboarding.

This is a description of the incumbent React UI, not a new brand direction. Source authority is `next-app/app/globals.css`, `next-app/components/ui.jsx`, `role-card.jsx`, and `app-shell.jsx`; the legacy root static UI is not the deployed visual reference.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender primary actions and active navigation.
Rounded controls with generous touch targets.
Wrapping layouts and responsive content grids.

rules.name: Onboarding surface exception
rules.body: Only onboarding uses the approved static companion setup room within the full-screen dark-glass setting. The selected companion is centered in a focused speaker area, with three participant radio tiles in a 190px right sidebar from 768px or a bottom strip on mobile. The selected tile reads Focused, with a nameplate and joined status explicitly marked Preview only. Pale cyan selection, 16px room corners and 10px participant corners are scoped patterns. No live-call controls or motion; animation:null reserves future media. Shared workspace tokens remain unchanged.

dos: Do reuse the shared color tokens and `ui.jsx` controls.
Do retain the global focus indicator, 44px minimum control height, wrapping behavior, and reduced-motion handling.
Do use surface tones and borders to separate shared panels.
donts: Don't use the legacy root static UI as the reference for new React screens.
Don't replace data-driven rarity accents with primary action styling.
